FEAT-3-S113.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S113.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure contract consistency across layers.

FEAT-3-S114.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S114.description: Integrate clinical trials service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate validated inputs, invoke search logic, and return structured results for tool consumption.

FEAT-3-S115.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S115.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool in tool_router with proper input validation, routing, and error handling within the agentic tool-use loop.
